summary: Delft Circuits announced a partnership with Bluefors to integrate Cri/oFlex quantum I/O into Bluefors dilution refrigerators.
quote: Helsinki, Finland & Delft, Netherlands, September 30, 2025 – Bluefors, the world leader in cryogenic measurement systems, today announced a strategic partnership with Delft Circuits to offer their turnkey quantum input/output (I/O) solutions.
